_comment: REFERENCE CATALOGUE. Every other locale is measured against this file's keys. Keys are stable identifiers: rename a key and every catalogue must change with it (catalogue_lint_test.go fails otherwise). Values are PLAIN TEXT - no HTML, because the page applies them with textContent so router-supplied and user-supplied strings can never reach the HTML parser (see internal/app/dom_sink_test.go).
title: TollGate Installer — Router Setup
scan.scanning: Scanning for routers on your network...
scan.none: No routers answered. Here is what was tried.
scan.timeout: The scan did not finish in time. Here is what was tried.
scan.unreadable: The scan could not be read. Here is what was tried.
scan.fail.heading: Why the scan could not report
scan.fail.timeoutBody: The installer did not answer within 20 seconds, so nothing is known about your network from this page.
scan.fail.unreadableBody: The installer's answer could not be read, so nothing is known about your network from this page.
scan.fail.try1: 1. Type the router's IP address in the box below and press "Use this address" - the wizard identifies it directly, without discovery.
scan.fail.try2: 2. Then check the cable: on the GL-MT3000 the 2.5 GbE port is WAN and the 1 GbE port is LAN - plug into LAN.
scan.fail.try3: 3. Or run the headless installer: bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenTollGate/tollgate-installer/main/install-and-test.sh) <ROUTER-IP> '' <you@wallet.app>
scan.fail.gateways: Default gateway(s) from the routing table
scan.fail.noGateway: (none — this host has no default route at all)
scan.fail.remediation: What to try, in this order
manual.label: Router address
manual.hint: Know the router's IP address? Type it - the wizard identifies it directly.
manual.invalid: That is not an IPv4 address. Use four numbers separated by dots, e.g. 192.168.1.1.
manual.noAnswer: No answer from {ip} - check the cable, the port and the address.
manual.unreachable: Could not reach the installer to identify {ip}.
select.label: Select your router
select.customTitle: Type the router's address when the scan missed it — for example the router is on a different subnet
trust.button: Trust this router's SSH host key
trust.lead: Waiting for you: this router's SSH key is not trusted yet, so nothing has been sent to it.
trust.nextWithFp: Check that fingerprint on the router's own console, then press Deploy: the wizard asks once, remembers the key, and only then sends your router password.
trust.nextNoFp: Verify the router on its own console, then press Deploy.
trust.confirmTitle: Trust this router's SSH host key, then continue?
trust.confirmBody:
Verify this exact fingerprint on the router's console first, e.g.
  ssh-keygen -lf /etc/dropbear/dropbear_ed25519_host_key.pub

It is remembered, so you will not be asked again for this router.

Trusting a key you have not verified would send your router password to an impostor on the LAN.
trust.confirmTitlePlain: Trust this router's SSH host key?
trust.cancelled: Cancelled: the router's SSH host key was not confirmed. Nothing was sent to the router.
trust.failed: Could not trust the router's host key. Nothing was sent to the router.
trust.installerUnreachable: Could not reach the installer to record the trust decision. Nothing was sent to the router.
trust.staleKey: The router now presents {fp} — verify THAT on the router console, then click Trust again to confirm it.
trust.remembered: Router host key trusted and remembered in {store}.
trust.networkError: Network error while trusting the router host key.
password.placeholder: Current router password (leave blank on a fresh reset)
password.notRequired: ✓ This router needs no password — continue.
password.status.notRequired: ✓ This router needs no password — continue.
password.status.refused: ✗ Wrong router password — the router refused the login.
password.status.missing: ✗ This router needs a root password (it refused an empty one).
password.status.untrusted: ⚠ Router host key not trusted — trust it, then the password is checked.
password.status.unreachable: ● Router not reachable over SSH yet — check the address and cable.
password.status.unknown: ● Could not verify the password yet.
upstream.label: Upstream connection
upstream.ssidHint: Choose the WiFi network to repeat.
wifi.passwordChanged: Router password changed — press Rescan to refresh the network list.
wifi.enterPassword: Enter the WiFi password to test
wifi.failedReachable: WiFi test failed — is the router reachable?
wifi.scanSelectRouter: Select a router to enable WiFi scan.
wifi.scanInFlight: A scan is already running — waiting for it to finish...
wifi.scanCheckPassword: {error} — check router password and try Rescan.
wifi.noNetworkList: Scan returned no network list. Try Rescan.
wifi.noNetworkListAttempts: Scan returned no network list. Attempts: {detail}
wifi.found: Found {n} network(s). Select one to repeat.
wifi.foundVia: Found {n} network(s) via {strategy}. Select one to repeat.
wifi.networkError: Network error during scan. Try Rescan.
wifi.movedRouter: A router answers at {ip}. Rescan to select it, then run the scan again.
lnurl.label: Lightning address
lnurl.hint: Lightning address (you@wallet.app) or raw LNURL (lnurl1...). Required.
advanced.adminPlaceholder: Leave blank for the default: TollGate
advanced.adminHintBefore: Optional. The router's admin password — you sign in to the board with it. Leave blank to install the default
advanced.adminHintAfter: and choose your own at first login.
advanced.wifiHintBefore: Optional. The management WiFi that YOU (the operator) join to reach the router. Leave blank to install the default
advanced.wifiHintAfter: and choose your own at first login.
advanced.adminTooShort: The router admin password must be at least 8 characters (or leave it blank for the default).
advanced.wifiTooShort: The management WiFi password must be at least 8 characters (or leave it blank for the default).
cleanSlate.label: Clean slate (advanced)
cleanSlate.selectBoard: Select the detected board to enable flashing
devsplit.label: Dev split
devsplit.hint: Share of payments routed to the TollGate developer fund. Default 21%.
margin.label: Margin
margin.hint: Operator markup added on top of data costs. Default 21%.
mint.label: Cashu mint preference
mint.hint: Which Cashu mint the router should prefer for ecash payments. Minibits temporarily removed (DLEQ keyset rotation bug).
forceflash.label: Force reflash firmware (ERASES router config; upgrades to the pinned OpenWrt release)
forceflash.hintBefore: Normally skipped when the router already runs OpenWrt. Enable to run
forceflash.hintAfter: onto the pinned release (e.g. 24.10 → 25.12), then continue the deploy on the clean system.
deploy.fixUpstream: Fix the upstream WiFi connection to unlock Deploy.
deploy.enterUpstreamPass: Enter the upstream WiFi password — Deploy unlocks after a successful test.
success.title: TollGate is live!
success.subtitle: Your router is now a Bitcoin WiFi hotspot.
success.body: Connect to the WiFi network and open any website to see the payment portal.
credential.title: The router's new root password
credential.warnSuccess: Your router had no root password, so it was set to the default. The value is shown ONCE here, and a copy is also saved to a file on this machine (mode 600) before you close or reload this page. Change it to your own after you log in to the router's admin board.
credential.warnFailure: This deploy failed AFTER the router's root password had already been set. The value is shown ONCE here, and a copy is also saved to a file on this machine (mode 600) before you close or reload this page — you will need it to reach the router.
credential.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the password above and copy it manually.
credential.savedTo: A copy is saved on this machine: {path}
pending.title: TollGate installed — the merchant is still starting
pending.detail: The merchant is still loading its wallet and mint health.
pending.up: The merchant is up — the board and the captive portal are live.
pending.starting: Still starting — give it another minute, then Re-check again.
pending.unreachable: Could not reach the router — it may still be coming up.
error.title: Setup failed
error.unknown: Unknown error. Check the log above.
error.versionUnavailable: version info unavailable on this installer build
lang.label: Language
lang.saved: Your choice is remembered on this browser.
